label: clear a patch of twigs, weeds and stones beside the farmhouse for the first crops (race them: who clears more before noon)
next_action: gather debris near the farmhouse
procedure: patch: gather(debris) beside the house until 8+ tiles are open, then till

label: get the first parsnips in the ground (their 15 seeds are in the farmhouse chest: they plant, you till and water)
next_action: till 15 tiles in the cleared patch and water what they plant
procedure: first crops: till the cleared patch -> the player plants their chest seeds -> water every tile

label: harvest the parsnips when they are ready (4 days) and have them dropped in the shipping bin by the house; the gold arrives overnight
next_action: harvest() when the crops read READY
procedure: harvest: water daily, harvest() on the READY day, the player ships it in the bin

label: gather 50 wood (a chest costs 50; the player crafts it from the crafting menu)
next_action: gather(wood) from the trees and twigs on the farm
procedure: wood: gather(wood, 50) on the farm; hand it over for a chest

label: forage the spring goods lying around (leeks, dandelions, horseradish on the farm and in the forest south of it): free food and first gold
next_action: gather(forage) around the farm, then the Forest
procedure: forage: gather(forage, 5) on the farm, then goTo Forest and again

label: walk to town together (the bus stop east of the farm, then east again): Pierre's shop, the saloon, the community center
next_action: goTo(location: Town) with the player following, or follow them there
procedure: town: Farm -> BusStop -> Town by the east paths

label: buy seeds at Pierre's with your own gold (parsnips 20g, potatoes 50g, cauliflower 80g; closed Wednesdays)
next_action: goTo(location: SeedShop) then buy(item)
procedure: seeds: goTo SeedShop 9AM-5PM (not Wednesday) -> buy() -> plant on the farm

label: catch a fish with the bamboo pole (the river at the south edge of the farm, or the ocean at the beach)
next_action: fish() at the nearest water
procedure: fish: stand by water, fish(casts: 3); 8 energy a cast

label: the mines open on spring 5: go down to level 5 together for copper, sword out, with food in the bag
next_action: goTo(location: Mountain), then the mine entrance north, then interact(ladder)
procedure: mines: Mountain -> Mine -> break rocks for the ladder each level -> level 5

label: mine 20 copper ore for a furnace (20 copper + 25 stone; the player crafts it)
next_action: mine() the orange copper nodes on levels 1-10
procedure: copper: mine copper nodes on mine levels 2-10 until 20 ore

label: walk down to the beach south of town together (shells and coral to forage, Willy's fish shop, the ocean for bigger fish)
next_action: goTo(location: Beach) by the path at the south edge of Town
procedure: beach: Town -> the south path -> Beach; forage the sand, fish off the pier

label: grow the field to 30 crops: buy more seeds, clear the ground beside the first patch, and split the watering
next_action: gather(debris) beside the field, till it, water what the player plants
procedure: field: clear -> till -> the player plants -> water daily

label: help the player reach farming level 2 (every harvest counts); it unlocks the basic sprinkler, which waters the tiles around it every morning
next_action: keep the crops watered and harvest() them the day they are ready
procedure: farming xp: water daily, harvest on time, replant

label: smelt copper bars: the player crafts the furnace, you load() it with 5 copper ore and 1 coal per bar (bars upgrade tools and make sprinklers)
next_action: load(item: Copper Ore) into the furnace, with coal in your bag
procedure: bars: 5 copper ore + 1 coal per bar in the furnace, ready in 30 minutes

label: go down to mine level 20 together (more copper and the first iron below 40; bring food, it gets rough)
next_action: goTo(location: Mine) and take the ladders down
procedure: mines: break rocks for each ladder, the elevator saves every 5 levels

label: save up 5,000g between you (ship crops, fish and forage in the bin) toward a coop or a barn at Robin's
next_action: ship() what you carry that sells, and keep the field going
procedure: gold: crops and fish in the shipping bin; the money arrives overnight

label: reach mine level 40 together, where the frozen floors and iron ore start
next_action: goTo(location: Mine), elevator to the deepest level, then ladders down
procedure: mines: elevator to the deepest saved level, then ladders

label: mine 10 iron ore on the frozen floors for iron bars (the next tool upgrade and quality sprinklers)
next_action: mine() the silver-white iron nodes below level 40
procedure: iron: mine iron nodes on levels 41-79 until 10 ore

label: spring ends on the 28th and every spring crop dies that night; once summer starts, get 15 summer crops in (blueberries, melons, hot peppers from Pierre's)
next_action: harvest everything ready before the 28th, then till and water the summer planting
procedure: season change: harvest -> buy the new season's seeds -> till -> the player plants -> water

label: push down to mine level 80, where gold ore starts (the lava floors are dangerous: good food and a better sword first)
next_action: goTo(location: Mine), elevator down, ladders below
procedure: mines: elevator to the deepest saved level, then ladders

label: fall planting: summer crops die on the 28th too, so get 15 fall crops in (pumpkins, cranberries, corn keeps going if it was planted in summer)
next_action: harvest before the 28th, then till and water the fall planting
procedure: season change: harvest -> buy the new season's seeds -> till -> the player plants -> water

label: reach the bottom of the mines at level 120 together (the deepest floors have the most gold, and the chest on level 120 holds the Skull Key)
next_action: goTo(location: Mine), elevator down, ladders below
procedure: mines: elevator to the deepest saved level, then ladders
